name: MyMemory Translation API
description: MyMemory is a free translation memory and machine translation API. It provides translations from a large collaborative translation memory with over 1 billion segments, combined with machine translation fallback. The free tier allows 1000 words/day without signup; providing a contact email or an API key raises limits and unlocks private translation memory features.
